name: Flutterfly Dust

narrative.details:
I'm sure you've noticed the giant flutterflies out in the outer fields near the orchard? They are pleasant to look at, but they also have other benefits; namely their wing dust. It can be a mess, but if you can gather it up in large amounts, it has useful household applications.

Take this Flutterfly Swatter and give the big bugs a good swat for me. They'll usually just get scared and flee, but sometimes they'll take some offense. Either way, they'll give their rumps a shake and drop a pile of dust.
narrative.objectives: Gather 5 Flutterfly Dust from the Flutterflies around the Gustberry Lowlands.
narrative.offerRewardText: This stuff can be a bit messy and it tends to get everywhere. You'll probably be shaking this out of your trousers for weeks, unfortunately. I do appreciate it, though. I've had this on my to-do list for weeks, but getting too far from the house when it's just me on my own with bandits lurking everywhere is a big risk.Don't bother asking me what I use this stuff for. Things. Stuff and things. Don't worry about it.
narrative.requestItemsText: Flutterflies are normally docile and calm, but rub them the wrong way and sometimes they'll surprise you.
